interpretation: Full R577 supports overall metric-depth gains over B0 and a small conditional average F1 increment over R500. It does not establish a further overall-accuracy gain over500 or robust F1 improvement over B0. Stable criterion is met by only one seed,and fixed samples retain negative cases. Preserve these results without tuning.
